note: Real-device testbed (PHONE-1, owner phone test 1 Aug). The canonical portrait profiles every capture/measure/profile run drives, so 'works on my desktop' can never masquerade as 'works on a phone'. Shared single source: the TS wrapper (deviceProfiles.ts) and the Node capture script (capture-phone.mjs) both read THIS file, so a profile is edited in one place. Widths/heights are CSS px (the layout viewport); dpr is the real deviceScaleFactor; reducedMotion drives Playwright's reducedMotion + the app's prefers-reduced-motion.
